description: Returns the link where a website owner can style a Calcupedia calculator and get the code to embed it on their own site (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix or plain HTML). Customizing needs no account; creating the embed needs a free Calcupedia account. Use it when someone wants a calculator on their website, blog or online store.

slug.description: Calculator slug from search_calculators, for example "mortgage-calculator".

name: get_embed_link
title: Get embed link
